description.value: Cohere Inc. is a Canadian AI company founded in 2019 by Aidan Gomez, Ivan Zhang and Nick Frosst. It builds large language models and generative AI products, mainly for regulated sectors.
Cohere Inc. (Toronto, Ontario, Canada) is a privately held artificial intelligence company.
Cohere sells enterprise AI; its flagship offering is North, an agentic enterprise AI platform that customers control and deploy on their own terms.
Cohere is a Toronto-based enterprise AI company founded in 2019 by Aidan Gomez, Nick Frosst and Ivan Zhang.

product_description.value: Platforms North and Compass; Command, Transcribe, North Small Translate, Parse, Embed, Rerank and Aya models; Model Vault dedicated inference and Private Deployments.
Command models (Command A+, Command A Reasoning, Command A Translate, Command A Vision), Cohere North (a secure AI workspace), and Aya Vision (free for research only).
Generative models Command, Aya and Expanse; retrieval models Embed and Rerank; workplace systems North and Compass.

business_model_description.value: Enterprise AI sold as a managed API and through Amazon SageMaker and Google Vertex AI; technology also embedded in Oracle and Salesforce products.
Revenue comes mainly from API access, with a rate-limited free tier, usage-based paid tiers and custom enterprise pricing for dedicated deployments.

customer_description.value: Financial services, public sector, technology, telecommunications, energy and utilities, healthcare, life sciences and manufacturing; named customers include Oracle, Dell Technologies, RBC, Fujitsu, SAP, Salesforce, TD Bank and McKinsey & Company.

Regulated sectors such as finance, healthcare, manufacturing, energy and the public sector; customers include Oracle, Salesforce, McKinsey, RBC, SAP, Dell, Bell Canada, Thales, Hanwha Ocean, Saab, Fujitsu, LG and Aston Martin F1.
Named clients include Fujitsu, Notion and Oracle; serves financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, energy and the public sector.

revenue.value: About $240 million, as reported by CNBC in February 2026.
$240M reported in February 2026, up from about $100M annualized in May 2025 and $150M in October 2025.
Sacra estimates $240 million ARR in 2025, up 287% from $62 million at end of 2024; Latka reports $85M in 2023 revenue.

headquarters.value: Toronto; San Francisco also listed as co-headquarters by one source
